candidates.notes: The replication effect (d=0.93, 95% CI [0.12, 1.72]) was in the expected direction but not statistically significant at the pre-registered Bonferroni threshold (p=0.105). The meta-analysis of original and replication was significant (p=0.0043), but the replication alone is inconclusive per the codebook's qualified support rule.
